αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)

βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’

γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλυκὺς: γλυκύς — sweet; masc. nom. sg., with ὕπνος: ’sweet’

δαναῶν: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. gen. pl.
δεῦρ: δεῦρο — hither, here; adv., elided (δεῦρ’ = δεῦρο)
δεῦρο: δεῦρο — hither, to this place; adv.
δουρὶ: δόρυ — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δορί)
δόμον: δόμος — house, home; masc. acc. sg.

εἶμι: εἶμι — go, will go; pres. 1 sg. with future sense (= Attic fut. of ἔρχομαι): ’I am going, I will go’
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θάλαμον: θάλαμος — inner chamber, bedroom; masc. acc. sg.
θεοειδέα: θεοειδής — godlike in form (θεός + εἶδος); masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic θεοειδῆ)
θεός: θεός — god; nom. sg. (also ’goddess’, θεός being common gender)
θεὰ: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’goddess!’
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’)

κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’)

κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κούρη: κούρη — girl, maiden; fem. nom. sg. (ἠΰτε κούρη ’like a girl’)
κρατερῷ: κρατερός — strong, mighty; adj., masc. dat. sg.
κτήμαθ: κτῆμα — possession, piece of property; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (κτήμαθ’ = κτήματα)
κὰδ: κατά (κάδ before δ-) — down; preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (κὰδ … λίποιεν = καταλίποιεν ’leave behind’)
κῦδος: κῦδος — glory, the lustre of success granted by a god; neut. acc. sg.
λάβεν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἔλαβεν)
λέχος: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. nom./acc. sg.
λακεδαίμονι: Λακεδαίμων — Lacedaemon, the Spartan land; fem. dat. sg., locative: ’in Lacedaemon’
λακεδαίμονος: Λακεδαίμων — Lacedaemon, the Spartan land; fem. gen. sg., after ἐξ: ’from Lacedaemon’

μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, by all means; adv.

μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black, dark; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα, standing epithet of ships
μενέλαον: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. acc. sg.
μενέλαος: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.

μύθοισιν: μῦθος — word, speech; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)

νέεσσι: νηῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νέεσσι (= Attic ναυσί)
νέον: νέος — young, new; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’lately, just now’
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’
οἴκαδ: οἴκαδε (elided οἴκαδ’) — homeward, to home; adv., -δε suffix of direction

πολίων: πόλις — city; fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic πόλεων)

ποντοπόροισι: ποντοπόρος — sea-crossing, sea-faring; adj. of two endings, fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.

προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)

πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πόσιν: πόσις — husband; masc. acc. sg. · also the distinct noun πόσις ’a drinking, drink’ (from πίνω); acc. sg.

πᾶσαι: πᾶς — all, every; fem. nom. pl., with πύλαι
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)

σεο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέο (= Attic σοῦ), enclitic
σιγῇ: σιγή — silence; fem. dat. sg., used adverbially: ’in silence’
σοῖσι: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι

τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl.

τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)

φαίης: φημί — say; pres. opt. 2 sg., potential with κε: ’you would say’

ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐεισαμένη: εἴδομαι — liken oneself to (+ dat.); aor. mid. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐεισ- (= εἰσαμένη): ’having made herself like’
ἐθέλει: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 3 sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκγεγαυῖα: ἐκγίγνομαι — be born from; perf. part. fem. nom. sg. (ἐκγεγαώς), + gen.: ’born of’
ἐμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with δαήρ
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναντίον: ἐναντίος — opposite; neut. acc. sg. as adv./prep. + gen.: ’in front of, before’
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐξαῦτις: ἐξαῦτις — again, once more, anew; adv., epic (= Attic αὖθις)
ἐπίκουροι: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. nom. pl.
ἐπαΐξας: ἐπαΐσσω — dart upon, rush at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’)
ἐρατεινῆς: ἐρατεινός — lovely, charming; fem. gen. sg., Attic form identical
ἐσσομένοισι: εἰμί — be; fut. part. masc. dat. pl., epic ἐσσομένοισι (= Attic ἐσομένοις): ’to those yet to be’
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’
ἐϋκνήμιδας: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, with good greaves; masc. acc. pl., standing epithet of the Achaeans
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑλένη: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. nom. sg.
ἑλένην: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. acc. sg.
ἑλοῦσα: αἱρέω — take, take hold of; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔοικεν: ἔοικα — be like, seem, be fitting; perf. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is fitting’ · also personal, ’is like’ (+ dat.: θεῇς … ἔοικεν ’is like goddesses’)
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔρχεσθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθε): ’go!’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠνίπαπε: ἐνίπτω — rebuke, chide; aor. 2 3 sg., epic reduplicated (ἠνίπαπον, no Attic equivalent)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’)
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει)
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’)
ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’whom’; not the possessive
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’ · also + gen. of the people or ships led: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχε … νεῶν)
ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (short ι by metre; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented, which the spelling cannot show)
ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. acc. sg.: ’equal’, or adverbial ’equally’
ἶφι: ἶφι — mightily, by force; adv. (instrumental -φι of ἴς)
ὀνόμαζε: ὀνομάζω — call by name, speak; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὠνόμαζε); ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζε ’spoke out, named’ in tmesis
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg.
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
ὄρινε: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; impf./aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤρινε): ’stirred’
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’)
ὧδέ: ὧδε — in this way, thus; adv., accented ὧδέ before the enclitic σφ’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥεῖα: ῥεῖα — easily, lightly; adv. (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
